Consonantal i

SearchHow we decideRulings

Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Church life

Lord, have mercy phrase

also Lord have mercy, Kyrie eleison, Kyrie

late Latin

Vulg. Ps. 122 (123), 3
Brev. Rōm., Tē Deum 27 (Latinitas Precēs)

Miserēre nostrī, Domine

Have mercy on us, Lord

misereor takes the genitive: miserēre meī, have mercy on me; miserēre nōbīs in the Glōria. The response of the litanies in both churches.

Other words

  • Kyrie, eleison — Lord, have mercy (in Greek)

    also used · late Latin · Miss. Rōm., Ōrdō Missae

    Greek Κύριε, ἐλέησον, in Latin letters: so it is sung in the Roman Mass, and so, in Greek or Slavonic, in the litanies of the Byzantine services. Greek in Latin letters is left without macrons, as the Missal prints it.

Examples

  • Miserēre nostrī, Domine, miserēre nostrī

    Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on usVulg. Ps. 122 (123), 3

  • Jēsū praeceptor, miserēre nostrī.

    Jesus, master, have mercy on us (the ten lepers).Vulg. Lc. 17.13

  • Quī tollis peccāta mundī, miserēre nōbīs.

    You who take away the sins of the world, have mercy on us.Miss. Rōm., Glōria

See also the Lord, prayer, amen.
